jobs.title: Procurement & Supply Chain Manager (100%)
jobs.description:
-
Local Procurement Leadership: You act as the primary procurement and supply chain point of contact in Iceland, supporting both Mammoth and Orca projects on-site.

-
Operational Procurement Support: You support project procurement activities, category management, MRO purchasing, and coordinate ad hoc logistics to ensure smooth operations.

-
Sourcing & Tendering: You run RFQs and RFPs, conduct supplier evaluations, lead negotiations, and prepare pre-award recommendations to drive best value outcomes.

-
Contract Management: You oversee post-award contract administration, including expediting and supplier performance follow-up to ensure timely delivery.

-
Supplier Base Development: You build, develop, and manage a robust local supplier network for industrial services, MRO, site support, and logistics.

-
Supply Continuity: You ensure uninterrupted supply by proactively managing risks, resolving supplier issues, and maintaining strong relationships.

-
Process Improvement: You continuously improve local procurement ways of working, enhancing efficiency, compliance, and collaboration across teams.
jobs.requirements_raw:
-
Education & Experience: You hold a Bachelor’s degree or bring equivalent experience in procurement, supply chain, engineering, operations, or business, and have 5+ years of relevant experience in procurement, MRO, category management, or project procurement.

-
Procurement Expertise: You have strong hands-on experience in RFQ/RFP management, supplier evaluation, negotiations, purchase order execution, and supplier relationship management (SRM), experience with SAP as an ERP system is a plus.

-
MRO & Operational Know-how: You understand MRO procurement processes and can operate effectively in project-driven or industrial environments.

-
Mindset & Approach: You are a self-starter with strong communication skills and a practical, solution-oriented mindset, able to prioritise and perform under pressure.

-
Languages & Mobility: You are fluent in English and open to around 10% travel, mainly within Iceland with occasional trips to Zurich.

jobs.title: Commercial Operations Manager (100%)
jobs.description:
As a Commercial Operations Manager, you will help build scalable operations across Climeworks Solutions, including our commercial, project sourcing and customer success teams. You will translate business needs into robust processes, tools, analytics, and ways of working, enabling us to move faster, collaborate better, and make decisions based on reliable data. Together with your team, you will help design and scale digital products including a platform enabling customers to manage and monitor their carbon removal portfolios, bringing greater transparency, accessibility, and impact visibility to the market. This is a problem-solver and builder role for someone who is excited to turn ambiguity into structure and to shape how a high-growth commercial organization operates, today and tomorrow.

-
Process & operational excellence: You define and continuously improve processes across marketing, business development, sales, project sourcing, and customer success, towards more standardised, digital, and scalable ways of working. You drive adoption through documentation, training, and continuous feedback loops and act as a trusted sparring partner for operational topics.

-
Business analysis & solution design: You lead stakeholder meetings and workshops to understand business needs, map processes, define requirements, and translate them into practical solutions. You prioritise requests, manage trade-offs, and ensure improvements align with business priorities, system architecture, and available capacity.

-
Salesforce administration, marketing & sales tools: You act as Salesforce Administrator for Climeworks Solutions, working closely with the Senior Salesforce Engineer and Tech team. You configure, maintain, and optimise Salesforce and related commercial tools, enabling efficient and effective system usage.

-
Analytics, reporting & data quality: You create reports and dashboards in Salesforce, Power BI, and Microsoft tools to monitor business performance and support decision-making. You conduct ad-hoc business analyses and own data quality controls and improvement measures.

-
Project & change management: You drive operational improvement initiatives, coordinate stakeholders, and communicate outcomes through clear project updates and presentations.

-
Knowledge management: You develop and maintain an internal knowledge base of processes, tools and enablement materials, making it easy for teams to access and apply best practices.
jobs.requirements_raw:
-
Education & experience: You hold a university degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Science, Engineering, Sustainability, or a related field and bring at least 5 years of experience in a fast-paced, service-oriented environment such as consulting, technology, scale-ups, or startups.

-
Commercial operations & business analysis: You have experience in business analysis, revenue operations, commercial excellence, product management, or similar roles and can translate business requirements into system configurations, data models, reports, and practical business solutions.

-
Salesforce & business systems: You have hands-on experience administering Salesforce, including user support, permissions, configuration, validation rules, flows, reporting and dashboards. You are comfortable designing solutions, testing and rolling them out, and driving user adoption. You bring experience operating and integrating commercial technology stacks, ideally including marketing automation, CRM extensions, reporting tools, and ERP systems such as SAP. Salesforce Administrator certification is a plus.

-
Stakeholder management: You enjoy working with and supporting others and collaborate effectively with stakeholders across functions and seniority levels.

-
Organisation & execution: You synthesise ambiguous challenges into actionable work packages, prioritise effectively, and drive initiatives through implementation with a proactive, diligent, and self-directed approach.

-
Mindset & ownership: You demonstrate a high degree of ownership, strong business judgement, and a bias for action and continuous improvement. You balance scalability and speed in a fast-changing environment.

-
Language: You have excellent written and spoken English skills.

jobs.title: Sorbent Module Product Owner (80-100%)
jobs.description:
-
Product Development Ownership: You take ownership of developing innovative sorbent modules from approximately TRL3 to TRL6, optimizing trade-offs between product requirements, performance, manufacturability, and scalability.

-
Lifecycle Management: You lead the lifecycle management of new sorbent modules from TRL6 through product launch, service, and end-of-life, ensuring successful product deployment and long-term performance.

-
Validation & Industrialization: You coordinate the validation of new products through serial production delivery, initiating and driving all engineering, manufacturing, testing, and validation activities required for successful industrialization.

-
Cross-Functional Collaboration: You work closely with in-house technology, development, and operations teams, as well as external collaborators, suppliers, and partners, to ensure seamless product development and delivery.

-
Prototype Fabrication & Testing: You support the fabrication and testing of prototypes, conducting experiments to validate design concepts, troubleshoot issues, and refine product performance.

-
Continuous Improvement: You drive the continuous improvement of sorbent modules by identifying opportunities to enhance product performance, reliability, manufacturability, and cost-effectiveness throughout the product lifecycle.
jobs.requirements_raw:
-
Educational Background & Experience: You hold an advanced degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field and bring at least 5 years of industrial experience in product development, mechanical design, or design engineering.

-
Design & Engineering Expertise: You have hands-on experience with material selection, Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DfMA), Design for Maintainability (DfM), and Design for the Environment (DfE), combined with a basic understanding of chemical processes and associated energy and productivity trade-offs.

-
Project Leadership: You have a proven track record of successfully managing development projects from concept through implementation, coordinating engineering activities and ensuring delivery through collaboration with cross-functional teams and external vendors.

-
Innovation & Problem Solving: You bring strong creative problem-solving skills and a passion for advancing sustainable technologies, with a particular interest in contributing to early-stage R&D and product innovation.

-
Collaboration & Communication: You are an effective communicator who enjoys working across multidisciplinary teams, mentoring junior engineers, and managing IP-sensitive collaborations with third-party suppliers and partners.

-
Language Skills & Availability: You are fluent in English and comfortable operating in an international, collaborative engineering environment. You are available to work 80–100% and are willing to travel up to 10% as required.

jobs.title: Lead EIC Engineer (100%)
jobs.description:
-
Technical Direction: You define and maintain the technical direction for the Electrical, Instrumentation, and Controls (EIC) Department. You lead the development of fit-for-purpose EIC specifications, design philosophies, and basis of design for execution Globally. You ensure owner requirements are clearly defined, documented, and communicated to contractors, and validate design assumptions against operability, safety, and ensure compliance with local and regional codes and regulations.

-
Contractor management: You review and approve contractor submissions including power distribution, control system architecture, and instrumentation design, enforce owner requirements, provide technical clarifications, and ensure adherence to schedule, quality, safety, and operability. You set clear expectations for execution methods, field quality controls, and turnover documentation needed for safe operation and maintenance.

-
System Reliability & Innovation: You lead initiatives to improve reliability and performance of EIC systems, troubleshoot issues, and implement preventive measures. You evaluate and introduce emerging technologies such as smart instrumentation, advanced control systems, and energy efficiency solutions.

-
Cross-Functional Collaboration: You act as the primary EIC interface with process, mechanical, and project management teams to ensure integrated designs. You identify and mitigate EIC risks during design and operation phases and support project teams with scope, cost, and schedule estimates.

-
Team Leadership & Continuous Improvement: You supervise and coach junior team members, provide guidance on technical challenges, and drive lessons-learned sessions to maintain a strong knowledge base and promote continuous improvement. You maintain thorough records of technical decisions, design bases, vendor information, and lessons learned for future operational use.

-
Cold-weather and constructability: As our next DAC plant is planned for Alberta, Canada, you incorporate Alberta (or similar) climate conditions into EIC design and execution planning (freeze protection, winterization, insulation/heat tracing philosophy, cold start/commissioning constraints). You ensure the design is constructable and able to operate and be maintained through winter conditions, including consideration of temporary works, winter work sequencing, and interface constraints with cold-weather activities.
jobs.requirements_raw:
-
Professional experience: You have a bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent and have at least 10 years of experience in process plants, preferably in cold weather climates, as an Electrical Controls and Instrumentation Engineer. You have experience leading teams.

-
Project experience: You have hands-on involvement in at least one full-cycle project in the mining, water treatment, oil and gas or other comparable industries, covering all phases from FEED and detailed design to construction, commissioning and start-up; preferably in cold-weather or remote/seasonally constrained execution environments. You have expertise in low and medium voltage electrical systems, industrial instrumentation, and control systems.

-
Communication & Collaboration: You demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills and can liaise with diverse stakeholders, including third-party vendors in IP-sensitive collaborations.

-
Working Style: You are precise, adaptable, and reliable, with a proactive and solution-oriented approach. You are comfortable driving decisions and owning them in the office and under field constraints, including winter productivity and schedule risk. You are highly organized, able to plan and prioritize work for yourself and others, and comfortable working in fast-paced environments.

-
Language Skills and Travel: You are fluent in English and ready to travel up to 60% of your time (including extended site presence in Alberta, Canada during peak design, engineering, construction and commissioning periods).

jobs.title: Principal Design Engineer - Mechanical Equipment (80-100%)
jobs.description:
-
Engineering Solutions: You provide technical leadership and expertise in the industrialization of mechanical components and systems, transforming concepts into integrated, robust and reliable industrial equipment products. You deliver innovative engineering solutions that ensure proper validation and enable scalable, high-quality manufacturing and serial production.

-
Product Design & CAD: You technically lead, create, and optimize product designs, using CAD tools (e.g., SolidWorks) to develop integrated systems, component assemblies and 2D manufacturing drawings. You ensure full technical readiness of the products according to the development plan.

-
Cross-Functional Collaboration and Leadership: You work closely with cross-functional teams and act as the expert for mechanical design, component integration, and manufacturability. You mentor less experienced engineers, provide technical guidance in decision-making, and manage external design resources to ensure their efficient integration into the development process.

-
Quality Assurance & Technical Readiness: You ensure the technical correctness and completeness of the design, from specifications to manufacturing drawings and bills of materials, with a strong focus on compliance with organizational and industrial standards.

-
Approval of Technical Documentation: You take full ownership as the approval authority for technical product documentation. This includes the review and approval of engineering drawings and the corresponding bill of materials. You lead design review presentations and uphold high standards to ensure accurate, traceable, and audit-ready development documentation that supports compliance and continuous product improvement.

-
Prototype Development & Testing: You define validation units, coordinate their fabrication, and participate in testing activities. You ensure that all test findings are transferred into product improvements.
jobs.requirements_raw:
-
Education & Engineering Expertise: You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering and bring deep, expert level expertise in engineering fundamentals and complex system development.

-
Advanced Mechanical Engineering Application: You have a proven ability to apply advanced engineering principles,

development methodologies, and analytical techniques to the design of large industrial equipment components.

-
Mechanical Design & Manufacturing Knowledge: With 12+ years designing mechanical components for industrial machinery, you bring expert metal and sheet metal design skills, strong knowledge of key manufacturing processes, and proficiency in DFMA, material selection, and regulatory compliance (with internal and industrial standards). You deliver robust, reliable design solutions.

-
CAD Proficiency & Technical Skills: You are proficient in designing mechanical components using CAD and in creating high quality technical drawings. You are experienced in applying geometric dimensioning and tolerancing chains and understand the corresponding manufacturing processes.

-
Attention to Detail & Problem-Solving: You have strong attention to detail, excellent organizational skills, and a passion for problem-solving and creative engineering.

-
Communication & Teamwork: You communicate effectively in English, collaborate confidently with cross-functional teams, and enjoy mentoring and guiding less experienced engineers. You contribute to a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement, while actively expanding your own expertise and advancing your engineering career.
